rationale: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is the best-supported fit. The measured experiment experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (evidence scope: measured_ci_workflow_on_fork) showed adding timeout-minutes cut median elapsed time by ~26.8%, and the pattern reports custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption (12.9% free / 8.1% paid VM time reduction). The repository's CI history shows successful runs complete in about 4-6 minutes total, so a 30-minute per-job timeout gives ample operational headroom and will not truncate valid runs while bounding stuck/runaway jobs. No matrix, schedule, or Bazel build exists, so fail-fast, schedule, and Bazel patterns do not apply. All existing steps, needs ordering, and required checks are preserved; no permissions, secrets, publishing, or new network access is added.
